item.title: 150 Switches
item.description: I got lots of wonderful little gifties for my recent birthday, but one of the most out-there was a bag of 150 Assorted Rocker Slide and Toggle switches from Jameco. It's literally a 2 pound scoop of switches in a plastic bag, sealed and mailed. Thanks Mom and Dad!
